author: D

components.title: Filter valid orders and deduplicate
components.what: Keep only shipped or pending orders, remove exact duplicate rows, and compute revenue as units times unit_price for each order.

components.title: Aggregate revenue by customer
components.what: Sum revenue per customer across the filtered orders.

components.title: Find highest customer revenue share
components.what: Divide the maximum customer revenue by total revenue and express as a percentage to one decimal place.
